title: Aureline M5 responsive-class and fallback-placement vocabulary
description: Companion vocabulary schema for the M5 shell-zone matrix. Freezes the three responsive classes resolved before applying a surface family's fallback ladder, and the ordered collapse placements a slot occupant may move through under compact widths, zoom, or secondary displays. A responsive collapse never changes task identity and never hides critical state: critical state stays docked or moves to a keyboard-reachable overflow, and the ladder always terminates in an in-slot placeholder that preserves the surface identity and reopen path. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-shell is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the shape consumed by the layout subsystem.

fallback_ladder.description: Ordered collapse placements; MUST terminate in `placeholder`.

responsive_class.description: compact_desktop: narrow width, zoom, or compact secondary display. standard_desktop: default working width. expanded_desktop: wide primary display.

fallback_placement.description: docked: remains in declared zone. sheet: opens as a sheet attached to the zone. overflow: reachable through a keyboard-accessible overflow route. placeholder: in-slot placeholder preserving identity and reopen path.
